jobs:
  dast-full:
    name: OWASP ZAP full scan

    if: false

    continue-on-error: true
    # #1756: pinned to a LITERAL GitHub-hosted runner, not the usual
    # `vars.RUNNER_LABELS_TEST` self-hosted-capable fallback. zaproxy/action-full-scan
    # is a Docker-outside-of-Docker action (it internally runs `docker run` against the
    # ZAP image) — on a self-hosted runner whose own process runs inside a container,
    # the workspace bind-mount resolves against the DOCKER HOST path, not the runner's
    # own checkout. GitHub-hosted runners are not containerized this way and are
    # unaffected. Enforced by scripts/check-docker-action-runner-safety.mjs.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # E4 (#1502): the PR-path dast-baseline (02-pr-extended) consolidated here at
      # nightly cadence. Start the application so the full active scan has a live
      # target — the prior nightly scan pointed at localhost:8080 with nothing running.
      - name: Start application
        run: docker compose up -d --wait
      - name: ZAP full scan
        uses: zaproxy/action-full-scan@d2a07475d467566c9a3e3c700f31f47724aa1060  # v0.10.0
        with:
          target: 'http://localhost:8080'
          fail_action: false
          artifact_name: zap-full-report
          cmd_options: '-J zap-report.json'
      - name: Stop application
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down

  dep-cve-refresh:
    name: Dependency CVE refresh
    # #1756/#1767/#1785: was previously pinned to a LITERAL GitHub-hosted
    # runner on the (later disproven, #1767/#1785) assumption that
    # GitHub-hosted runners are immune to the Docker-outside-of-Docker
    # workspace-bind-mount defect that docker-container actions hit on a
    # self-hosted runner whose own process runs inside a container. That
    # literal pin also puts this job on paid GitHub-hosted minutes, which
    # fails outright on billing/spending-limit issues (#1904). The
    # typescript branch's osv-scanner step (#1767) is now a pinned static
    # binary and the java branch's Trivy fs step (ADR-104) is a composite
    # action with no workspace bind-mount — no docker-container action
    # remains in this job, so scripts/check-docker-action-runner-safety.mjs
    # does not flag switching back to the shared self-hosted-capable runner.
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNER_LABELS_TEST || '[\"ubuntu-latest\"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-pnpm
      - name: npm audit
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - name: Install osv-scanner (pinned static binary)
        # #1767: google/osv-scanner-action is a Docker-outside-of-Docker
        # action. A static binary has no workspace bind-mount to break,
        # sidestepping the class of bug entirely.
        run: |
          mkdir -p \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\"
          curl -sSfL -o \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/osv-scanner\" \\
            https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases/download/v2.3.8/osv-scanner_linux_amd64
          echo \"bc98e15319ed0d515e3f9235287ba53cdc5535d576d24fd573978ecfe9ab92dc  $RUNNER_TEMP/bin/osv-scanner\" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/osv-scanner\"
          echo \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" >> \"$GITHUB_PATH\"
      - name: osv-scanner (prod-dependency gate; dev-only findings warn, not block)
        # #1786: dev-only vulnerable packages are reported but non-blocking,
        # matching the npm-audit step's --omit=dev prod-only policy.
        run: |
          # FAIL-OPEN-INTENT: osv-scanner exits non-zero whenever ANY vuln is found (incl. dev-only); the real gate is the prod-only check below.
          osv-scanner scan source --lockfile=package-lock.json --format json --output-file osv-results.json || true
          PROD=$(jq '[.results[]?.packages[]? | select((.vulnerabilities // []) | length > 0) | select((.dependency_groups // []) | index(\"dev\") | not)] | length' osv-results.json)
          DEV=$(jq '[.results[]?.packages[]? | select((.vulnerabilities // []) | length > 0) | select((.dependency_groups // []) | index(\"dev\"))] | length' osv-results.json)
          if [ \"$DEV\" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo \"::warning::osv-scanner: $DEV dev-only vulnerable package(s), not gating\"
            jq -r '.results[]?.packages[]? | select((.vulnerabilities // []) | length > 0) | select((.dependency_groups // []) | index(\"dev\")) | \"  - \\(.package.name)@\\(.package.version)\"' osv-results.json
          fi
          if [ \"$PROD\" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo \"::error::osv-scanner: $PROD production-impacting vulnerable package(s)\"
            jq -r '.results[]?.packages[]? | select((.vulnerabilities // []) | length > 0) | select((.dependency_groups // []) | index(\"dev\") | not) | \"  - \\(.package.name)@\\(.package.version)\"' osv-results.json
            exit 1
          fi

"
